adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U show a sustained ~5–6 mm drop in N and E around index 485–490, followed by gradual recovery through ~515; U shows a smaller ~2–3 mm drop and recovery. P1 (485–509) aligns with this coherent multi-axis offset and return. P2 (504–517) overlaps P1 and has tiny onset offsets (<0.5 mm), inconsistent with a distinct temporary platform; residual plots show no isolated step at 504. P3 (514) is a single-point spike, not a platform. Hypotheses P1–P3 subtracting different onsets all fail to flatten the interior motion—only P1 subtraction yields residuals resembling noise without artificial jumps. No evidence for independent temporary platforms beyond P1.
